title: fix(hono): createHonoApp's two catch arms answer a declared ADR-0112 envelope as declared, not as 500 (#23365)
body:
Fixes #23365
Clause-②: yes (widening): one added export of `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`, which was module-private

## What this does

`createHonoApp` (`@objectstack/hono`) has two catch arms: the `${authMount}/*` mount's and the `${prefix}/*` catch-all's around `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()`. Both answered `errorJson(c, err.message || 'Internal Server Error', err.statusCode || 500)`, reading `statusCode` alone. A throw that declared `status` and a registered `code` therefore lost both on this host and answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.

Both arms now go through one helper, `thrownJson`. It asks `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`, the recogniser #16545 landed for `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`'s direct-mount routes, and renders the envelope it returns. When the recogniser answers `undefined`, the arm's old line runs unchanged. No second recogniser is written. The recogniser was module-private, so it is now exported from `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` (its `src/index.ts` already does `export * from './adapter'`, so `adapter.ts` is the only file that changes there). That export is why line 2 reads `Clause-②: yes`, against the claim's `no`; the dispatch order names this exception. **The seat re-grades.**

## Readings on the wire (real `createHonoApp` over the real dispatcher and protocol, in-memory SQLite)

Taken at `167cebe824` (fix) against `84672ff876` (pins only, adapter unchanged). Both are on this branch, and both sit on `origin/main` `869a381dc9`.

| Row (producer) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` / `PATCH` / `DELETE /data/task/no_such_row` (core `recordNotFoundError`, via the protocol) | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` "Record no_such_row not found in task" | `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` |
| `PATCH` with a stale `If-Match` (protocol `ConcurrentUpdateError`) | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE`, row unchanged |
| `DELETE` with a stale `If-Match` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE`, row kept |
| `PATCH` / `DELETE` with `If-Match: ""` (protocol `MalformedVersionTokenError`) | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, row untouched |
| The ADR-0069 gate's session read fails (`AuthzStoreUnavailableError('auth_gate')`, raised by `enforceAuthGate` above `dispatch()`'s `try`) | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, no cause in the body |
| Auth mount: the auth service's `handleRequest` throws `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, no cause in the body |
| Control: a bare `Error` (with a `cause`) on either arm | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, keys `code` and `message` | unchanged |
| Control: a throw that declares `statusCode: 503` and no code (`callData`'s shape) | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | unchanged |

## Mechanism hypotheses, as measured

- **(a) The two arms.** Confirmed on `869a381dc9`. Both lines were `index.ts:782` (auth) and `:831` (catch-all) and read `statusCode` only.
- **(b) The recogniser.** `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` reads `resolveThrownHttpError`. Its `declaredStatus` comes from `.status`, then `.statusCode`, then the 400 that a validation-shaped throw declares. It requires that status to be a key of `HttpStatusErrorCodeMap`, and the producer's own `.code` to parse as `ErrorCode`. It renders `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details?, userMessage? } }`, and on 5xx it applies `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` to the message. `@objectstack/hono` could not reach it through any existing export, so the export was added.
- **(c) Declared throws.** All five measured; see the table.
- **(d) The 409 body.** It does **not** carry `currentVersion` or `currentRecord`. The after-fix body is `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"CONCURRENT_UPDATE","message":"Record task/ID was modified by another user (current version T1, expected T0)"}}`. The recogniser forwards only the `details` that a producer declares (non-string `code`, `issues`, validation `fields`). `ConcurrentUpdateError` keeps the two fields as own properties, and only `RestServer`'s classification arm reads them (`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`, the `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` arm). Per the ruling, the recogniser is not widened here. This is reported to the seat as a finding.
- **(e) The auth-mount arm.** No in-repo producer was found that reaches it with a declared envelope. better-call 1.4.0's router (the one better-auth's handler runs) turns a handler throw into a `Response`: an `APIError` becomes its own `Response`, and anything else becomes a bare `500`. The dispatcher's `handleAuthRequest` catches the auth service's throw itself. The arm takes the same rendering for uniformity: one rule, not two. Its pin uses a host-supplied auth service whose `handleRequest` throws.

## "No cause in the body"

Read as: the body of a non-envelope throw gains nothing. It gets no `cause`, no `details` and no `userMessage`; it carries `code` and `message` only. Each control row asserts exactly that, with a cause whose text must not appear in the body. The old fallback line is unchanged byte for byte, so a bare `Error`'s own message is still in its `500` body, as it was before. `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts` already pins that (`returns error on dispatch exception`), and this PR leaves that pin alone. Withholding the message of an undeclared 500 on this host would be a separate behaviour change; see the acceptance notes.

## Tests

- New: `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-declared-envelope.conformance.test.ts`, 13 rows. Before the fix: 9 failed, 4 passed (the four controls). After: 13 passed.
- `@objectstack/http-conformance`: 13 files, 137 tests passed. `typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`) is green, and `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` counts 13 of 13 test files, the new one included.
- `@objectstack/hono`: 7 files, 154 tests passed; `typecheck` green.
- `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`: 29 files, 336 tests passed; `typecheck` green.

## Ablation (one leg per arm, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode plus an outer `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore)

In http-conformance's `vitest.config.ts`, the subject `@objectstack/hono` is aliased to `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`, so a mutation of the source reaches the run without a build.

- **Catch-all arm** reverted to the old line. The anchor hit once, x1 to x0; the blob went `3529a20128d4` to `51939c434b24`. Result: **8 failed, 5 passed**. All 8 catch-all declared pins went red. The controls and the two auth-arm rows stayed green.
- **Auth arm** reverted to the old line. The anchor hit once; the blob went `3529a20128d4` to `4314a9ba898d`. Result: **1 failed, 12 passed**. Only the auth-arm declared pin went red, and its bare-`Error` control stayed green.
- Restore was proven for each leg: the blob equals HEAD (`3529a20128d4`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 66 commands at `287fd99bda`. 65 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads the whole tree's `dist/`), which counts as NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it. `--ran` reports 66 derived, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the diff's three `.ts` files exited 0, linting 3 files with 0 errors and 0 warnings. Positive control: a stdin file in `packages/adapters/hono/src/` importing a root namespace from `@objectstack/spec` exits 1 (`no-restricted-imports`). Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.

## Changeset

`.changeset/23365-hono-declared-envelope.md`, `minor` for both packages. `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` is `minor` because `Clause-②: yes` (an added export) takes at least `minor`. `@objectstack/hono` is `minor` to match #16545's level: that change applied the same rule to the direct-mount door and shipped as `minor` (`cefe068702`). The wording follows that changeset's sections.

## Acceptance notes

- On this host, an undeclared 500 still carries the thrown message verbatim, with no `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` filter. It was already the case before this change, and it is unchanged here. Noted only; not filed.
- For a declared 5xx, the recogniser keeps the message unless `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` fires. The dispatcher's own exit withholds the message of every declared 5xx (commit 0783d7b80). The two Hono doors agree with each other by construction, but not with that exit. Noted only.
- `main` gained `989aa483fd` and `0be162c75d` after the base. Neither touches `packages/adapters/hono`, `plugin-hono-server`, `http-conformance`, the dispatcher or `@objectstack/types`, and `git merge-tree` is clean, so the branch was not merged; the merge queue rebuilds on `main`.
